segments.say: A monster with a human face looks up at Jin and begs him to *kill* it.
To see how it got here, go back to the warehouse where Jin drugged his own team and went in *alone*.
Two guards chat about girls, until Jin drops from the shadows and *wrecks* them.
A blood circle only opens for *human* blood, so Jin cuts a guard and uses that.
The circle glows red, and it turns out the guard was not human *anymore*.
The two guards swell into red-eyed giants with muscles on top of their muscles. *Damn*.
Jin goes for the head. They stand back up. He goes for the heart, and they *regenerate*.
Jin smirks. These are biological golems, forbidden magic, and each one hides a *core* somewhere.
Head, nothing. Heart, nothing. That leaves the *abdomen*.
He shatters the first core, slices through the second, and the red glow finally *dies*.
But the last body is still alive, and it is *crying*.
Jin steps up to it and says one *word*.
The full story is on our channel.
